requirements_summary: Primary workload: reranking and real-time decisioning for programmatic bids. Targets: sustained 5k rps with burst to 15k rps; p50 < 5ms, p95 < 20ms, p99 < 50ms end-to-end for model decision call. Cost sensitivity: target cost per decision <$0.0006. Model preferences: open weights (Llama2-13B / Mistral-family) with fallback to smaller distilled models. Critical features: per-route batching with latency SLO overrides, prefix/KV caching to reduce repeated token costs, quantization (int8/int4) recommendations but must validate quality on Copperleaf holdout dataset. Security: Okta SSO (SAML), AWS KMS integration, SOC2 compliance, US data residency and audit logs retention for 12 months.
perf_benchmark_requests: End-to-end replay with Copperleaf traffic profile (cold start, warm cache, burst 15k qps)
Tail-latency profile: measure p50/p95/p99 and 99.9th under sustained load
Batching sensitivity study: latency vs cost curve for batch sizes 1-16 with real request seq lengths
KV/prefix cache efficiency test: estimate hit-rate and token savings on 2-week sample
Quantization QA: int8 and int4 accuracy delta on rerank NDCG and mismatch rate threshold
Routing/fallback test: evaluate cost-aware routing + graceful fallback to smaller models under capacity pressure
